title: The Gift of a Lantern
description: Ms. Bai from Qingce Village seems to be making some preparations...

mainQuestExcel.title: The Gift of a Lantern
mainQuestExcel.description: Ms. Bai from Qingce Village seems to be making some preparations...

dialogs.text: How do you do, Traveler? Thanks for your help last time. Qingce Village hasn't been this lively in a while now.
You're most welcome.
In previous years, only Zhi and I were around, so we could only make the children a few Xiao Lanterns, talk to the old folks about some domestic business, and whip up a few good dishes...
But with your help, we were able to have a lively Lantern Rite this time.
But I guess we should look to return to normal now... I should see to the elderly folk in the village. I'm meant to go see Jiangcheng today.
If you don't mind, could you come along with me?
Lead the way.
Alright. Then let us go to his place first.
Is it you, dear? Are you back?
I'm sorry, you must've mistaken me for someone else...
Nonsense, I haven't lost my senses... How could I not recognize my own wife...
I was just telling you that, with such a huge festival just around the corner, maybe we should get some new clothes for our daughter...
Oh, I see you've brought a guest... A seamstress! Once again, you've read my mind!
Grandpa Jiangcheng, it's me, Ms. Bai! I brought you some Tofu the other day, surely you haven't forgotten me already?
Ah... Ms. Bai... Of course I remember you, Ms. Bai! Your father was telling me how proud he is of you not so long ago...
Eh... When was that? ...Dear, perhaps you remember...
...I remember.
Ha! Just like I said, there's nothing wrong with my memory... And, and...
Grandpa Jiangcheng, why don't you take some rest? No need to strain yourself...
Traveler, how about you help Grandpa Jiangcheng clean the house? I'll keep him company in the meantime.
Leave it to me.
Thank you.
Of course I do.

Uh... He... He's doing fine. The mill is still very much in business. The city folk from Liyue Harbor often come to the village just to buy our Tofu.
Haha... Sounds about right! Your father's Tofu is the pride of Qingce Village...

flow.stepDescription: Use Anemo or Hydro to help Jiangcheng clean the house

dialogs.text: Dear, come have a word with Ms. Bai... Her father is such a skilled craftsman...
They sell their Tofu in Liyue Harbor, it's top-quality!
Right! Ms. Bai, I forgot to ask what brought you here...
We brought you a Xiao Lantern.
Xiao Lantern... Ah... So considerate. You bring me those each year, Ms. Bai...
Do you remember, Dear? I used to make great Xiao Lanterns back in the day. Our neighbors liked them so much that they asked me to make some for them too.
Xiao Lanterns are so beautiful, they really light up each Lantern Rite... Wait, I'll hang it for you...
Let me hang it up.

Traveler, could you hang the Xiao Lantern now? I'll look after Grandpa Jiangcheng.

flow.stepDescription: Hang the Xiao Lantern on the house

dialogs.text: Did you hang the Xiao Lantern? Truly breathtaking. The upcoming year is bound to be another great one.
It sure will.
Grandpa Jiangcheng, it's time for us to leave now. We still have a few errands to run. I'll visit you again soon.
I see... Young people like you always have something to do... Can't get a moment's respite...
Goodbye.
Ah, sure. Dear... don't forget to look after our land...
Certainly.

I'm really grateful for your help. If I'd gone there on my own, it would've taken me hours to get everything done.
I didn't want to leave Grandpa Jiangcheng on his own right before the festival...
What about you...
Me... I'm going back to the mill. There's still much work to be done.
I inherited the mill when my father passed away. I left my job at Liyue Harbor to continue the family tradition.
I don't know if it makes sense, but doing the same things he used to do, being in the same environment, it makes me very nostalgic.
I often recall the many things that my father used to tell me, especially during this time of the year...
Oh, I almost forgot. With Grandpa Jiangcheng on my mind, I didn't make a Xiao Lantern for myself.
The problem is I didn't leave any spare materials either...
I'm afraid I won't get everything done in time if I go looking for materials now... Traveler, would you mind collecting some for me?
Not at all.
I really appreciate it.
What a pretty Xiao Lantern! The upcoming year is bound to be as great as this one.
